Definition: genitive case τριχός, etc.; of uncertain derivation; hair:--hair. Compare G2864.
BiblicalUsage: The word thríx carries the sense of hair. In Matthew 3:4, the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and it appears again in Mark 1:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hair still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
